description: Deployment and architecture docs, README and spec sync for M4. Plan item 8 in d:/github work/SDK workshop/.agents/tasks/heatwise-m4/plan.md. Depends on FEAT-001..003: read their findings for real numbers (test counts, asset size, synth resources, IAM statements). No invented numbers or prices.
steps: New heatwise-ai/docs/deployment.md (PowerShell commands, all exact): prerequisites (Node 22, uv, Python 3.13, AWS CLI v2, credentials from a profile/SSO, Bedrock model access to Nova 2 Lite in us-east-1/us-east-2/us-west-2, us-east-1 already CDK-bootstrapped so do NOT run cdk bootstrap); build the Lambda asset; create the infra venv; `npx --yes aws-cdk@2.1147.0 synth --all` and `diff`; deploy `npx --yes aws-cdk@2.1147.0 deploy HeatWiseData HeatWiseApi` (marked: user-approved step, creates billable resources); context options table (heatwise:* keys and defaults); smoke test with Invoke-RestMethod (GET /api/health, POST /api/assessments with the README body, poll GET /api/assessments/{job_id}, GET /api/reports/{report_id}); where logs are (the three log groups); optional frontend (build with VITE_API_BASE_URL='/', deploy with -c heatwise:frontend=true); idle cost (Lambda, HTTP API, CloudFront: no charge at idle; DynamoDB on-demand, S3, CloudWatch Logs: storage only; no NAT gateway, no provisioned or reserved capacity, no customer-managed KMS keys) and per-assessment drivers (Bedrock tokens, worker GB-seconds at 1024 MB arm64 x measured ~41 s, HTTP API requests incl. polling) with links to the official pricing pages and no invented prices; destroy: `npx --yes aws-cdk@2.1147.0 destroy --all`, then the RETAINed tables and bucket (how to find them with read-only list commands, then the delete commands marked destructive and irreversible), or deploy with -c heatwise:removal=destroy first; AgentCore option: prerequisites and the workshop CLI steps (`npm install -g @aws/agentcore --ignore-scripts`, `agentcore create`, `agentcore add` with Bring my own code + Direct Code Deploy, copy backend/ and point the entrypoint at backend/agentcore_entry.py, `uv init --bare --python 3.13` + `uv add` with the exact pins incl. bedrock-agentcore==1.25.2, `agentcore dev`, `agentcore deploy`, `agentcore invoke` with a session id of at least 33 characters, cleanup `agentcore remove all -y` then `agentcore deploy`), env SESSION_STORAGE=none, not deployed in M4.

New heatwise-ai/docs/architecture.md: mermaid component diagrams for local mode (uvicorn + thread jobs + JSON store + file sessions) and AWS mode (HTTP API -> API Lambda -> DynamoDB jobs + async invoke -> worker Lambda -> Bedrock US profile / Open-Meteo / DynamoDB assessments / S3 sessions; optional CloudFront); job sequence diagram; data classification (public weather data in reports, community-level profile in request_json, coordinator conversation in sessions; no personal data, extra='forbid'); DynamoDB key design table; IAM summary; decisions D-M4-1..10 with one-line rationale each.

heatwise-ai/README.md: M4 section: what changed, config table for the new env vars, local vs AWS mode, how to run the new tests (backend count from findings, infra tests), links to docs/deployment.md and docs/architecture.md; update any text saying jobs are memory-only.

.kiro/specs/heatwise-ai/requirements.md: tag Requirement 8 and 11 [M4] with short M4 notes (8.1 file/S3 session manager on the coordinator, session id per job; 8.2 DynamoDB when configured; 8.3 separation; 11.1 CDK stacks; 11.2 AgentCore entry documented, not deployed; 11.3 deploy/cleanup docs).

.kiro/specs/heatwise-ai/design.md: add '## 10. M4 design (persistence and AWS)' with 10.1 decisions D-M4-1..10, 10.2 job model (states, conditional transition, stale rule, retry 0), 10.3 DynamoDB keys, 10.4 sessions, 10.5 stacks/IAM/Bedrock routes with the doc URL and check date, 10.6 packaging, 10.7 tested behaviour (new test files and counts from findings). In §9.2 and §9.3 replace the 'M4 replaces the thread pool...' / 'M4 adds a DynamoDB implementation' sentences with pointers to §10. Update §4 repo structure (infrastructure/, docs/, new backend modules).

.kiro/specs/heatwise-ai/tasks.md: check 4.1-4.4 with sub-bullets naming the modules and requirements; add '### M4 findings' with: test counts (backend before/after, frontend 46, infra), asset size, synth results per stack (resource counts), IAM summary (Bedrock scoped; no wildcard actions on data stores; no AWS::ApiGateway::Account), deviations or gaps (e.g. history/metrics still rescan all records; constant GSI partition; AgentCore not deployed; no live AWS run), and 'Decisions before deploying' (API auth, removal policy, Bedrock model access, throttle/max pending/reserved concurrency/budget alarm, frontend hosting and CORS, log retention and PITR).
Final verification run (see verification) and record the results in this FEAT's findings.
